article.headline: Pennsylvania visits Navy after Power's 23-point performance
article.title: Pennsylvania visits Navy after Power's 23-point performance
article.linkText: Pennsylvania visits Navy after Power's 23-point performance
article.story: Pennsylvania Quakers (1-1) at Navy Midshipmen (2-1) Annapolis, Maryland; Wednesday, 5:30 p.m. EST LINE: Quakers -9.5; over/under is 149.5 BOTTOM LINE: Pennsylvania visits Navy after T.J. Power scored 23 points in Pennsylvania's 78-65 victory over the Howard Bison. Navy finished 15-2 at home last season while going 26-8 overall. The Midshipmen gave up 64.3 points per game while committing 14.4 fouls last season. Pennsylvania finished 4-8 on the road and 18-12 overall last season. The Quakers shot 44.1% from the field and 38.4% from 3-point range last season. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
